chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Jameel, from Murazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah has not been worshipped with anything more superior than the fulfilling of the rights of the believer.
ai.seo_question: What is the most superior act of worship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from Al-Kafi elevates 'adā' al-ḥaqq' (fulfilling rights) from mere social courtesy to a supreme act of worship ('ibādah), often compared to the excellence of prayer and fasting. It underscores the Imami emphasis on the inseparability of vertical devotion to God and horizontal social justice, reflecting the broader theological principle that communal rights are a manifestation of divine covenant.
